item.title: Reproducibility Report of ModernBERT Models for Retrieval Tasks Using DPR
item.description: Cross-posted here: https://api.wandb.ai/links/joe32140/zqs87nz3 Before We Start As researchers from LightOn.AI and Answer.AI released the ModernBERT models, a BERT redesigned for 2024, I was interested to see its performance on retrieval tasks as mentioned in their paper, specifically with DPR. However, they had not released the model checkpoints for all experiments. I decided to fine-tune ModernBERT on the MS MARCO dataset by myself based on the provided training scripts.
